messages.content: onno creator der content dekhe nijer confidence kome jai, eta normal?
Khub common feeling eta, comparison trap sobar e hoy. Tumi specifically ki compare korcho - quality, follower count, naki style?
Ei duita number diye actual success measure kora misleading, karon niche, timing, ar luck onek factor kaj kore. Nijer growth trend dekho onno der number er bodole, seta beshi meaningful.
